name: Rowe Scientific Chemistry Honours Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $5,000 for an SCU Bachelor of Science with Honours student doing a chemistry project.
who: Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Formal acceptance into the Bachelor of Science with Honours, studying chemistry.
Preference for disadvantaged students or students from rural, regional or remote Australia.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 100 to 200 word statement.
